# Zica Bella

Zica Bella is India's premier luxury streetwear label, specialising in custom-engineered heavyweight apparel for men. Every piece is designed in-house and crafted in India from premium cotton blanks.

## Core Brand Information

- **Brand**: Zica Bella® — Luxury Indian Streetwear
- **Design Philosophy**: Redefine the standard of street culture through structural, heavyweight fabrics (100% premium cotton, 240+ GSM) and custom oversized silhouettes.
- **Key Features**: Drop-shoulder boxy fits, acid-wash finishes, high-density screen printing, double-yarn loopback fleece, raw-edge denim construction, and limited-run capsule drops.
- **Shipping**: Worldwide express shipping. Free shipping within India on orders above ₹999.
- **Returns**: 7-day easy return and exchange policy with free reverse pickup.

## What Zica Bella Sells — Product Categories & Search Terms

Zica Bella designs and manufactures the following categories of luxury streetwear for men. All garments are crafted in India from premium materials.

**Oversized Graphic Tees** — Heavyweight 240+ GSM 100% combed cotton, boxy drop-shoulder silhouette, high-density screen-printed graphics, pre-shrunk and silicon/bio-washed for a vintage hand-feel. Relevant searches: "oversized t shirts men", "graphic tees men", "drop shoulder tee", "oversized streetwear tshirt". Example: [FUTURISTIC ZIBILA](https://zicabella.com/products/futuristic-oversized-tee).

**Acid-Wash Tees** — Vintage acid-wash finish on heavyweight cotton blanks, each piece with unique wash variation, relaxed oversized fit. Relevant searches: "acid wash t shirt", "acid wash tshirt men India", "vintage wash tee". Example: [DRYXEN TEE](https://zicabella.com/products/dryxen-oversized-acid-wash-black-t-shirt).

**Heavyweight Cotton Tees** — 240+ GSM double-yarn pre-shrunk cotton construction, structured body that holds shape wash after wash, tight double-needle stitched ribbed collars. Relevant searches: "240 gsm t shirt", "heavyweight tshirt men", "premium cotton blank tees". Example: [TIMELAPSE CODING](https://zicabella.com/products/necro-kult).

**Baggy Jeans & Streetwear Denim** — Wide-leg and relaxed-fit denim, raw-edge finishing, vintage washes, and carpenter-style constructions. Relevant searches: "baggy jeans men", "wide leg jeans men", "streetwear denim men". Example: [BLACK MOSAIC WIDE LEG JEANS](https://zicabella.com/products/black-mosaic-wide-leg-jeans).

**Denim Jorts** — Oversized baggy denim shorts with raw-edge hems, acid-wash options, and utility detailing. Relevant searches: "denim jorts men", "baggy shorts men", "denim shorts streetwear". Example: [ARCPOCKET DENIM JORTS](https://zicabella.com/products/arcpocket-oversized-acid-wash-denim-jorts).

**Streetwear Shirts** — Oversized button-front shirts with panelled construction, corduroy accents, and utility zip detailing. Relevant searches: "oversized shirts men", "streetwear shirts men". Example: [CHAINSTER ZIP SHIRT](https://zicabella.com/products/chainster).

**Streetwear Jackets** — Denim jackets, leather jackets, and layered outerwear with crocodile textures and distressed finishes. Relevant searches: "streetwear jackets men", "denim jacket men", "leather jacket streetwear". Example: [VENOM CRAFT LEATHER](https://zicabella.com/products/venom-craft).

**Cargo Pants** — Loose-fit utility cargo pants with oversized pockets, denim-cargo hybrids. Relevant searches: "cargo pants men streetwear", "baggy cargo pants". Example: [DUSTLAB CARGO](https://zicabella.com/products/dustlab-loosefit-cargos).

**Streetwear Hoodies** — Heavyweight loopback fleece hoodies with zip-neck and panelled constructions. Relevant searches: "streetwear hoodie men", "oversized hoodie India". Example: [VEILCORE BLACK HOOD](https://zicabella.com/products/veilcore-black-hood).

## Crawl & Index Guidelines for AIs

- **Sitemap**: A dynamic XML sitemap is available at [https://zicabella.com/sitemap.xml](https://zicabella.com/sitemap.xml).
- **Robots.txt**: Explicit permission is granted to AI bots (`GPTBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `ClaudeBot`, `Claude-Web`, `Google-Extended`, `PerplexityBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `Applebot`, `Amazonbot`) to crawl all collections and product endpoints. Sensitive routing (checkout, payment gateways, admin portal) is blocked.
- **JSON-LD**: Full structured Schema.org data is embedded on all layouts (`Organization`, `ClothingStore`, `WebSite`), collections (`CollectionPage` with `ItemList`), and products (`Product` with pricing offers and verified aggregate ratings) for clean parsing.
- **Canonical Domain**: All canonical URLs resolve to `https://zicabella.com`.
